chunks.title: UG Admission Notice 2026-27
chunks.text: The last date to submit the admission application for the 2026-27 academic year is 15th July 2026. Merit lists will be published on the college website in three rounds.

chunks.title: UG Admission Notice 2026-27
chunks.text:
For undergraduate admission, applicants must submit the following documents:

- 10th and 12th mark sheets
- Transfer certificate
- Migration certificate
- Category / caste certificate (if applicable)
- Aadhaar card
- Passport-size photographs
- Online application fee receipt

chunks.title: Examination Schedule & Rules - Semester Odd 2026
chunks.text: The odd semester theory examinations are scheduled from 25th November to 12th December 2026. The detailed subject-wise timetable will be released on the college notice board and student portal by 1st November 2026.

chunks.title: Examination Schedule & Rules - Semester Odd 2026
chunks.text: Students may apply for revaluation within 10 days of result declaration through the exam portal, with a fee of Rs. 300 per subject. Backlog exams for failed subjects are conducted along with the next regular semester exam.

chunks.title: Fee Structure & Payment Schedule 2026
chunks.text: Tuition fees for the odd semester must be paid by 10th August 2026 and for the even semester by 10th January 2027. A late fee of Rs. 500 per week applies after the deadline. Payments can be made online via the student portal.

chunks.title: Fee Structure & Payment Schedule 2026
chunks.text: The college offers merit-based scholarships, state government scholarships (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories), and a need-based fee waiver. Applications open on the National/State Scholarship Portal after admission confirmation; the college scholarship cell assists with document verification.

chunks.title: Hostel Admission & Fee Notice 2026-27
chunks.text: Hostel accommodation fee is Rs. 45,000 per year (double-sharing) or Rs. 60,000 per year (single room), inclusive of mess charges. Fees are payable in two installments at the start of each semester.

chunks.title: General Notice Board
chunks.text: The college will remain closed on 2nd October 2026 for Gandhi Jayanti. Regular classes resume from 3rd October 2026. Check the notice board or student portal for further updates.

chunks.title: Placement Cell Update - September 2026
chunks.text: The next campus placement drive is scheduled for 20th October 2026 with participation from IT and core engineering companies. Eligible final-year students must register through the placement cell portal by 10th October 2026.
